name: sym-tol-1e4
rationale: The original NH3 GAPW_XC crystal uses the default EPS_SYMMETRY1e-6 and10 irreducible points, while the GAPW-GTH extension uses1e-4 and4 points for the same nearly symmetric reference coordinates. Isolate that tolerance effect before interpreting representation differences of order0.02kJ/mol. Only add EPS_SYMMETRY1e-4, retaining the same full3x3x3 mesh, geometry, basis, model, grids, D3 and EPS_SCF. Use the exact accepted final restart on the original Spark executable/GPU model and8 threads. The frozen kpoint_io.F restart stores real-space density-matrix images and maps them by lattice-cell index; it does not require the old irreducible orbital count. Verify the actual4-point reduction and complete process provenance. This is not a full-versus-unreduced or k-mesh convergence test. The molecule is unchanged, so the accepted crystal-energy difference divided byZ is also the lattice-energy sensitivity to this tolerance. Do not count as another base case.
